answer: Admission writes each fable into ferrous, where every active identity holds a lease that decays each epoch and must be re-bought with tide. Leases expire together at the boundary, and renewal burns tide equal to the live identity count times a base rate, read fresh then. A thousand fakes must renew in one epoch, consuming a thousand squared base units of tide, so the pool admits only the square root of its size. Attacker pays tide per lease at each renewal in ferrous; this collapses if leases transfer or renewal windows stagger.
